Location: Outside of Leatherhead with beautiful surroundings and free on-site parking, you will need to drive for this role due to location

Salary: £31,250 FTE, (£16 per hour) salary will be pro-rata plus 20 days holiday plus BH (pro-rata), Xmas closure, birthday off, annual bonus, socials, high achievers' incentives and longevity within this friendly small team.

Hours: Ideally 4 days a week, can offer 3 days with flexibility on hours

Hybrid offered after 3-6 months training (depending on experience) for 1 to 2 days working from home

Are you an experienced Payroll & Accounts Assistant looking for a part-time opportunity with flexible hours?

Our client, a reputable organisation located in the picturesque Surrey Hills, is seeking a dedicated professional to join their friendly Accounts team. This is a fantastic chance to play an integral role in supporting payroll and accounts while enjoying a balanced work-life schedule.

Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, the Payroll & Accounts Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive payroll and accounts support. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys both teamwork and independent tasks. The organisation's finance team is adapting to new AI technologies, and this part-time position is crucial for maintaining efficiency in operations.

If you possess the required skills and experience and are excited about the possibility of contributing to a vibrant team, don't hesitate to apply!

title: Temporary Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new role
A skilled credit controller is required to join a business on a temporary basis. This is an urgent requirement, with an immediate start. This role can be worked predominately remotely with occasional travel to the company offices in Surrey. The temporary credit controller will be tasked with tackling the aged debt. Duties and responsibilities will include:
- Reviewing customer accounts to understand the true aged debt position
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Chasing aged and overdue payments by telephone and email
- Working with customers and internal colleagues to resolve queries and disputes
- Resolving misallocated cash
- Reporting on aged debt and attending regular aged debt reviews with management

What you'll need to succeed:
- Extensive Credit Control experience
- Experience of collecting debt from the NHS / public sector customers
- Account reconciliation experience
- Working with customer portals
- Confident working in a standalone, mainly remote role
- Excellent communication and relationship building skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Computer-literate

What you'll get in return
- Immediate start
- Mainly remote working
- Competitive hourly rate
